distance_from_cbd: 19 km (12 mi) southeast of the Melbourne CBD
housing_building_stock_character: Large 1950s-70s housing on big (~800m2) blocks, built to a high standard, now ageing and being renewed via subdivision into townhouses; commercial core with high-rise apartment development around the station.
source_quotes: Glen Waverley recorded a population of 42,642 at the 2021 census.
Major development occurred in the 1950s to 1970s with rapid infilling of housing built to a generally high standard on large (typically 800m2) blocks.
Much of that housing stock is now ageing and renewal is occurring, frequently involving subdivision of the larger blocks into townhouse development.
High-rise apartment blocks began featuring with the construction of IBIS Hotel... In 2011, IKON Glen Waverley was constructed as a 10-storey apartment, office, retail and car parking complex.
